name: Precise Numbers Effect
scenario: Submitting a detailed professional services proposal for systems integration and compliance remediation.
script: "The total implementation, testing, and SOC-2 certification delivery schedule is budgeted at $347,850 based on our audited resource allocation matrix."
defense: Strip the illusion: $347,850 rests on subjective hour assumptions; round to a ceiling and examine the day rates.
originFull: Numerical Cognition and Attribution of Competence demonstrate that non-round numbers (e.g., $348,650 vs. $350,000) lead counterparties to assume that the proposer used an exacting, mathematically rigorous methodology, resulting in significantly smaller counter-adjustments.
defenseFull: Strip the precision illusion: "The granularity of $347,850 implies empirical exactness, but it rests on subjective assumptions regarding required developer hours. Let us round this to an even operational ceiling and examine the underlying day rates."
